OTHER PRESENT:
 SR PP SMT SEETHA S  THIS BAIL APPLICATION HAVING COME UP FOR ADMISSION ON 17.01.2024, THE COURT ON THE SAME DAY DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 B.A.No.11204/2023  -:2:-
 Dated this the 17th day of January,2024

ORDER The application is filed under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973('Code', for short),
for an order of pre-arrest bail.

2. The petitioners are the accused in Crime No.581/2023 of Palarivattom Police Station, Ernakulam,
now re-registered as Crime No.1673/CB EOW/EKM/R/2023 of the Crime Branch, Economic Offence Wing, Ernakulam Unit, registered against them for allegedly committing the offences punishable under Sections 406, 420 & 34 of the Indian Penal Code,1860.

3. When the bail application came up for consideration on 18.12.2023, this Court passed an interim order, by directing the petitioners to surrender before the Investigating Officer within 10 days and subject themselves for interrogation.

4. Heard; Sri. P. Martin Jose, the learned counsel appearing for the petitioners; Smt. Seetha S., the learned Senior Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondent and Smt.Amritha Jaya Prakash, the learned counsel appearing for the third respondent/de-facto complainant.
5.

The learned Public Prosecutor, on instructions, submitted that, pursuant to the order dated 18.12.2023 passed by this Court, the petitioners appeared before the Investigating Officer on 22.12.2023 and their interrogation has been completed.
The petitioners' further presence is not required.
Hence, the interim order can be made absolute, subject to additional conditions.
The said submission is recorded.
